articleBodyHtml:
Understanding Fan Art and Its Value

Fan art is a creative expression that often draws inspiration from existing works, such as anime, manga, or video games. While it is not officially licensed, it holds significant value in the community. The speaker acknowledges that even though they cannot draw fan art themselves, the act of creating such art can be a source of income and personal fulfillment.

The speaker also discusses the idea that fan art, regardless of its origin, can be monetized. This highlights the blurred line between personal creativity and commercial use, emphasizing that the value of the art lies in its impact and reception rather than its official status.
